lines.en: \c[1]Interesting.  You really think it was a good idea coming here, do you?
lines.zh: \c[1]有意思。 你真的认为来这里是个好主意，不是吗？

lines.en: I-I... guess I saw something different about you.  Any of the others...
lines.zh: 我、我想我看到了你身上一些特别的地方。 其他任何人……

lines.en: Any of the others would've killed you on sight.  I sincerely hope for your sake that you have an answer for me.
lines.zh: 其他任何人都会在看到你的瞬间把你杀掉。 为了你自己的性命着想，我真诚地希望你能给我一个答案。
lines.name: 莱桑德

lines.en:
I... I understand.
While your interpretation of the texts is somewhat rudimentary, I believe it to be correct.  Well...  correct enough for your purposes.
If I am "correct enough", then how best to act on this information?  That said, it disturbs me that you were willing to risk your life to come here.  I know you have much to gain.
lines.zh: 如果我已经“足够正确”，那么根据这些信息，能采取的最佳行动是什么呢？ 说起来，我开始有些担心你冒着生命危险跑到这的目的。 我知道你会从中获益颇丰。
lines.name: 莱桑德

lines.en: B-begging your pardon, but we are not so different!
lines.zh: 原、原谅我这么说，但我们并没有那么不同！

lines.en:
Except that you serve a mad cult, and are so blinded by the promise of reward that you let yourself get kicked around like a dog.  I will not be following that path, Jebediah.
Our business is done.  Leave, following my exact instructions.  One deviation will likely be your last mistake... and mine.
lines.name: 莱桑德

lines.en: D-do not waste this chance to make things right...
\c[1]Interesting.  You really think it was a good idea coming here, do you?
lines.zh: \c[1]有意思。 你真的认为来这里是个好主意，不是吗？

lines.en: I-I... guess I saw something different about you.  Any of the others...
lines.zh: 我、我想我看到了你身上一些特别的地方。 其他任何人……

lines.en: Any of the others would've killed you on sight.  And if you don't have a good answer for me, they'll know you're here.
lines.zh: 其他任何人都会在看到你的瞬间把你杀掉。 如果你给不出一个让我满意的答案，他们就会知道你在这儿。
lines.name: 莱桑德

lines.en:
I... I understand.
While your interpretation of the texts is somewhat rudimentary, I believe it to be correct.  Well...  correct enough for your purposes.
If I am "correct enough", then how best to act on this information?  That said, it disturbs me that you were willing to risk your life to come here.  I know you have much to gain.
lines.zh: 如果我已经“足够正确”，那么根据这些信息，能采取的最佳行动是什么呢？ 说起来，我开始有些担心你冒着生命危险跑到这的目的。 我知道你会从中获益颇丰。
lines.name: 莱桑德

lines.en: B-begging your pardon, but we are not so different!
lines.zh: 原、原谅我这么说，但我们并没有那么不同！

lines.en:
Except that you are so blinded by the promise of reward that you let yourself get kicked around like a dog.  I will not let that happen to me.
Our business is done.
lines.name: 莱桑德

lines.en: I know you feel alienated by the Nephilim.  They do not deserve the power they wield.  But just...  just please don't hurt my Beatrix...
lines.zh: 我知道你感觉被圣灵疏远了。 他们配不上他们所拥有的力量。 可求你了…… 求你别伤了我的碧翠丝……

lines.en: ...  Pardon me?!
lines.name: 莱桑德

lines.en: Please...
..."Your" Beatrix?  What, do you think you can win over that unhinged harpy by coming to her rescue?
lines.zh: ……“你的”碧翠丝？ 怎么，你真的觉得你能通过英雄救美来赢得那个神经病妖女的心？
lines.name: 莱桑德

lines.en: Go home, Jebediah. You poor, misguided soul.
lines.zh: 回家去吧，耶比底亚。你这可悲的，入了歧途的灵魂啊。
lines.name: 莱桑德
